drivers.theme: Hawkish Warsh / September hike risk (~60% priced)
Oil spike above $91 on US-Iran strikes and Hormuz mining
Nvidia/AI capex strength but very high valuation bar
Fed credibility doubt, heavy issuance, steeper curve
Consumer fatigue in weak PCE/retail data

parsed.rationale: Hawkish Warsh repricing, an oil shock from renewed Iran strikes and soft consumer data outweigh Nvidia's AI bid; futures are softer pre-open. Payrolls and CPI loom, so I shade below the neutral drift at all horizons, only mildly fading the downside by day seven.
